Group rides in Illinois

7 recurring group rides around Illinois: 5 social, 3 road. 3 roll on weeknights, 2 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Femmes + Thems Bike Chi Monthly Social Ride in Chicago — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Major Taylor Cycling Club Chicago Big Ring runs a group 20+ mph, B group 17–18 mph.

I do the miles. You decide who they’re for.
